item.title: Midnight elephant intrusion sparks panic in Dhenkanal’s Kamakshyanagar
item.description: Panic gripped residents of Budhibili village under Kamakshyanagar block in Odisha’s Dhenkanal district after a lone elephant entered the locality late on Sunday night. The incident occurred within the jurisdiction of the Jiral Forest Section, leaving villagers alarmed. The elephant reportedly strayed into the village around midnight, heightening fear among locals who have been witnessing elephant movement in nearby areas over the past few days. item.title: Former Railway Minister and TMC leader Mukul Roy passes away in Kolkata at 70
item.description: Former Railway Minister and senior Trinamool Congress (TMC) leader Mukul Roy passed away on Monday at a private hospital in Kolkata. He was 70. Roy suffered a cardiac arrest at around 1.30 am at Apollo Hospital in Salt Lake, his son Subhranshu Roy confirmed. A founding member of the All India Trinamool Congress, Roy played a key role in shaping the party’s early organisational structure.
